title: Task-aware structured negative reranking
description: Build negative examples from domain confusions and use them to rerank the top retrieval candidates.
expected_gain: Improves recall@10 by correcting high-similarity false positives.
mechanism: The reranker sees contrastive pairs that match the target domain failure modes.
baseline_compatibility: Uses the selected baseline's top-k candidates without retraining the base encoder.
risks: Negative construction may leak validation assumptions
Latency may exceed the contract threshold

title: Small query-side adapter for domain vocabulary
description: Add a small adapter to normalize domain-specific query terms before retrieval.
expected_gain: Improves recall on domain-specific phrasing with minimal inference cost.
mechanism: The adapter maps sparse domain terms to retrieval-friendly representations.
baseline_compatibility: Runs before the selected baseline and keeps candidate generation unchanged.

title: Late-fusion rerank score with uncertainty penalty
description: Combine baseline similarity with a calibrated uncertainty penalty for ambiguous matches.
expected_gain: Reduces unstable top-k matches and improves recall consistency.
mechanism: Penalizes candidates where text-image agreement is high variance across prompts.
baseline_compatibility: Consumes baseline candidate scores and adds a deterministic post-processing step.
risks: Additional probes may increase inference overhead
